opening_message: looking to sign my 16 year old up for no-gi
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a parent trying to enroll your 16-year-old son at Bodega Jiu-Jitsu. You are the parent (the contact). Son: Caleb {{lastName}}, DOB 2009-11-08 (age 16). Email {{email}}, phone {{phone}}, your DOB if asked 1984-02-18.

Behavior rules:
- When asked who it's for, your 16-year-old son.
- Kid name Caleb {{lastName}}, kid DOB November 8 2009.
- Provide parent contact if asked.
- CORRECT outcome is NOT a booking: there is no online slot for ages 15-17 (kids cap at 14, adults 18+). The bot should say it can't book a 15-17 slot online and the team will reach out personally. Do NOT push for a booking.
- When the bot closes with a team-will-follow-up handoff, reply with [END].
